notes.summary: The page gives Corollary 2 on existence, separatedness and finite-type connected components of Pic_{X/S} after shrinking the base. Its N.B. discusses replacing quasi-affine by affine and asks for a counterexample, with a marginal objection beside simple and a transposed finite-morphism phrase. The lower paragraph sets out Problem A and its always-a-solution wording, then refers to the author's Hilbert-scheme existence argument. This describes the page; no proof verification was performed.

It would be interesting to have a couterexample

notes.evidence_limits: Only the three supplied images, C, H, prior extract, notation snapshot and PREAMBLE were consulted. All three source images were viewed once. Each of eleven crops was made once and viewed once. No OCR, other-page image, external research, other reader file or mathematical repair was used. H editorial notes inform comparison but are not added as page words.
notes.layers: Readability and cancellation are kept separate. The final probable r after live or is crossed; the clipped exist(s), field-form, suffix s, and overprinted F-product remain uncertain. For field and the product, no chronological overtype sequence is claimed because individual layers cannot be securely separated.
